verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhook event logs in the Customer Area (adyen-docs-45) and general webhook mechanics to avoid polling (adyen-docs-3/17), plus an MCP tool to 'test' webhooks (adyen-supp-mcp-tools) that hints at replay tooling. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents HMAC/signature verification for webhook payloads, an automatic retry policy for failed webhook deliveries, or a dedicated replay mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit signed-webhook (HMAC) verification docs, documented automatic retry/backoff schedule for webhook delivery, and a concrete replay/redeliver feature beyond the vague MCP 'test' tool.
